people.title: Person lookup
people.subtitle: Find a parent, educator or staff member by phone: their relationships, invites and sign-in state.
people.privacy: Support never sees PINFLs or answers.
people.readOnly: You can look people up but not act: resending invites and cancelling sign-ins belong to support.
people.startBody: Enter the number the person uses to sign in. You will see everything linked to it, including invites sent to it before they registered.
people.invalidTitle: This number can't be looked up
people.invalidBody: Check the number: it needs +998 and 9 more digits, for example +998 90 123 45 67.
people.notFoundBody: No account uses this number. Invites waiting for it and any sign-in in progress are shown below.

signin.title: Sign-in
signin.requestsNone: No sign-in has been started with this number recently.
signin.limitFmt: The "too many starts" limit is counting this number's sign-in starts for another {min} min. Cancelling a sign-in resets it.

resend.already: Already resent today — one resend per invite per day.

cancelLogin.dlgBody: The person's sign-in stops and they start again from the beginning. This also lifts the "too many starts" limit for this number.
cancelLogin.done: The sign-in was cancelled and the start limit lifted.

roles.title: Staff roles
roles.subtitle: Who holds which staff role. A role's permissions are fixed in code; here you only assign them.
roles.instant: Changes take effect at once — the person's next page load already sees the new role.
roles.revokeBodyFmt: {name} loses "{role}" immediately, with everything it allows.
roles.grantSub: The person must have signed in to Zinapo once with this number.

desc.item_author: Writes items to the template; sees only their own items and statistics.
desc.item_reviewer: Two-hand review: solves blind, then critiques; never their own items.
desc.bank_editor: Approves and retires items, anchors, builds and freezes forms, runs calibration.
desc.season_manager: Seasons, waves, regions and schools; sends bulk reminders.
desc.olympiad_operator: Olympiad events, stages, venues, registrations, results and awards.
desc.proctor: Runs an in-person final; never one where their own child competes.
desc.trust_safety: Fraud flags, disputes, manual reviews, educator applications, link suspensions.
desc.support: Looks people up by phone, resends invites, resets stuck sign-ins. Never PINFLs or answers.
desc.outcomes_operator: Imports official admission lists and reviews unmatched rows.
desc.super_admin: Staff roles, system settings and the audit log. Inherits no other role.
